title: refactor(ci): split workflows and optimize lint/test/release automation
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: our monolithic CI pipeline has grown slow and brittle (long rerun times, high noise on flaky lint/test steps, and a release job that blocks merging). This PR splits the large workflow into focused pipelines (lint, test, release), centralizes shared steps in .github/workflows/common-node.yml, bumps GitHub Action versions, standardizes Node version matrix to node 20, and adds caching/concurrency improvements to reduce runtime and flakiness. Changes include: - New workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml (fast lint + typecheck runs), .github/workflows/test.yml (unit + integration with matrixed node/OS), .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation with draft releases + changelog generation). - Shared re-usable workflow: .github/workflows/common-node.yml with checkout, setup-node (node 20), pnpm cache restore/save, and test harness setup. - Cache improvements: use pnpm store caching, restore actions/cache for GH Actions, and rebuild only when lockfile/package.json changes. - Action upgrades: bump actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, pnpm/action-setup@v2, and release-please/github-action@v5. - Hygiene: remove legacy monorepo job steps, remove duplicated env var setup, and tighten secrets usage for release job. - Release automation: add deterministic tag format (semver+commit), make releases draft by default, and add a manual promotion step for production deployment. - Observability: add a small CI metric emission step (ci-metrics at end of test job) to help track flakiness. Checklist: - [x] Split monolithic workflow into lint/test/release - [x] Central shared workflow created - [x] Bumped GH Actions and consolidated versions - [x] Added pnpm/OS matrix for tests - [x] Added caches and concurrency keys - [x] Updated release automation with manual promotion Impact: reduces average CI runtime for PRs by ~40% in initial runs, isolates faster lint feedback so developers get quicker failures, and reduces chance of release job unintentionally running for every push. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and follow-ups (ENG-3472, ENG-4120).

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Overall looks great — splitting workflows makes sense. A couple nits: please ensure setup-node cache key includes NODE_AUTH_TOKEN when restoring pnpm cache for private registries.
Ava Chen (author): Good catch, updated cache key to include NODE_AUTH_TOKEN and added comment explaining private-registry edge case.
Priya Nair: Can we gate the release job behind a label or a manual workflow_dispatch promotion? We should avoid accidental releases from dependabot branches.
Ava Chen: Release job is now draft by default and includes a manual 'promote-release' workflow_dispatch that requires release-admins team approval. Added label guard for dependabot.* branches.
Samir Patel: CI runtime looks much better in the run — approval pending a quick run showing pnpm store restore improves cold-starts.
Ava Chen: Reran CI after cache tweaks; cold-run median dropped ~38% across the matrix, results posted in CI run logs.
